english.note: Use 話 as the all-purpose spoken verb for conveying information or saying something, including 話畀人知 for informing someone.

exampleSentences.english: I’ll tell you that we don’t have to work tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我話畀你知，聽日唔使返工。
